title: ALMOST Normal
description:
This is a Modpack for a better Vanilla experience. still works on server
Fabric 1.21.11
Almost Vanilla
body:
**WORKS IN SERVERS**

This is _almost_ Vanilla, the only true changes for the server Side being structures and World generation. 

# How does this work?

its quite simple actually. While servers dont allow Server side mods, generation mods still can be used. It wont affect Gameplay in the server, but it wont kick you out. (Servers just dont allow custom items, blocks, etc.)

# What changes does the Modpack do?

It has a LOT of texture Packs (please go through all of them and also check compability) and it changes how the game looks. this includes a dark loading screen, tips during world loading, smooth scrolling and more. It also gives you features that can be VERY useful for gameplay, like organization or finding out where you put your items.

This modpack can be low weight without shaders, but it also brings some shaders in your folder, that can vary from low to high weight.

and also, you can use this to your liking, as in unlocking the modpack and putting your own mods in. if you have trouble loading this, unlock it like told and check which mod it is.

Your settings should automatically change during loading, can be configured. The settings change comes to what your pc can handle.



_Names_
V1: Almost Vanilla
